BFAREATARGETS.None: No tokens inside the placed template.
BFAREATARGETS.SettingAutoTargetHint: After an activity places an area template, target every token whose centre falls inside it.
BFAREATARGETS.SettingUseTargetsHint: Let the save, check and damage buttons on a chat card act on targeted tokens. Without this Black Flag uses only the tokens you have selected.
BFAREATARGETS.SettingClearName: Clear ability templates when the turn changes
BFAREATARGETS.SettingClearHint: Delete area templates placed by abilities when combat advances to the next turn or combat ends. The area lasts for the action that made it.
BFAREATARGETS.KeybindClearHint: Delete every area template placed by an ability on the current scene.
BFAREATARGETS.NoneToClear: No ability templates on this scene.
